column1: # Default adult reference table for the numbers reader. A reference range given in the input always wins.
# Ranges are typical adult intervals, rounded; cross-check against general references such as Kratz A et al.,
# "Laboratory reference values", N Engl J Med 2004;351:1548-63, and the MedlinePlus lab-test pages. Local laboratory
# ranges differ; children (age < 18 known) never get findings from this table (age bands are future work).
# analyte: canonical name (the LABS label where one exists); aliases: "|"-separated, matched as whole words,
#   case-insensitive except those in case_sensitive (also graded weak, they are ambiguous: Na, K, Ca, ...);
# hpo_low / hpo_high: term for a value below low / above high (blank = none); plausible_low/high: values outside this
#   are skipped when the unit is missing. Hemoglobin and ferritin use the union of the sex-specific ranges.

column2: WBC|white blood cell count|white blood cells|white count|leukocytes
